message.content:
I’m not sure if you’re looking for an individual guard or a security‑services company, but here are a few ways to find the most popular options in New York: | What you’re looking for | How to find it | Popular choices in NYC | |--------------------------|----------------|------------------------| | **Individual guard** | • Search local job boards (Indeed, LinkedIn, Glassdoor) for “security guard” listings in NYC.
• Check community forums (Reddit r/NYC, Nextdoor) for recommendations.
• Ask friends or coworkers for referrals. | • Many guards work for agencies, so you’ll usually find them through a company. | | **Security‑services company** | • Use Google Maps or Yelp to search “security guard services New York City.”
• Look at BBB (Better Business Bureau) ratings and customer reviews.
• Check industry sites like Security Industry Association (SIA) for accredited firms. | • **Securitas** – One of the largest global security firms with a strong NYC presence.
• **G4S** – Offers a wide range of security solutions in the city.
• **Allied Universal** – Known for both guard services and integrated security tech.
• **ADP Security** – Provides guard services and workforce management.
• **New York City Police Department (NYPD) Contracted Services** – For municipal contracts, though usually for larger events. | ### Quick steps to find the “most popular” 1. **Search & Compare** - Google “security guard services NYC” → look at the top 5–10 results. - Open each company’s website, note their service offerings, and check for client testimonials. 2. **Read Reviews** - Yelp, Google Reviews, and BBB ratings give a quick sense of customer satisfaction. - Pay attention to the number of reviews and overall rating; a high rating with many reviews is a good sign. 3. **Check Credentials** - Verify that the company holds the necessary NYS licensing (e.g., NYS Department of State, Division of Licensing Services). - Look for certifications such as ISO 27001 (information security) or ISO 9001 (quality management) if you need higher assurance. 4. **Ask for References** - A reputable firm will provide references from past clients. - Contact those references to confirm reliability and professionalism. 5. **Get Quotes & Compare** - Request detailed quotes from at least three companies. - Compare rates, coverage hours, and any additional services (e.g., CCTV monitoring, incident reporting). 6. **Trial Period** - If possible, negotiate a short trial period before committing to a long‑term contract. - This lets you evaluate guard performance and fit with your environment. ### Quick links - **Securitas NYC** – https://www.securitas.com/us/en/locations/new-york-city - **G4S NYC** – https://www.g4s.com/locations/new-york - **Allied Universal NYC** – https://www.allieduniversal.com/locations/new-york - **ADP Security NYC** – https://www.adp.com/our-services/security.aspx If you need a guard for a specific event, venue, or business, let me know the details (e.g., type of event, duration, security level required), and I can help narrow down the best providers for that scenario.
